assertions: He will not obtain the parsonage (benefice) he desires — the suit for this specific benefice fails

No link perfects between the querent's significators (lord of the Ascendant and the Moon) and Jupiter, lord of the 9th, significator of the benefice: no aspect, no reception, no translation or collection of light between them
Neither the lord of the Ascendant nor the Moon is placed in the 9th house, so there is no placement testimony for attainment of the benefice

Saturn impedited in the Ascendant 'infortunes' the question and the querent himself — impediment, delay and loss of his former credit continue, and his pressing covetous suit is hindered from his own side
The Moon, separating from a trine and applying to an opposition of Mercury, lord of the 3rd, brings adverse news, letters or intermediary talk rather than help toward the benefice
Venus in the 7th house opposing the Ascendant shows opposition from the other party / opponent side, blocking agreement or grant to the querent
method: Classical horary astrology (Lilly, Christian Astrology Book II) — significator, aspect, reception, translation/collection of light analysis
reasoning: 本题应验跨度为单次成败、无近远两段进程。本断仅依输入所给盘面证言链：土星受困于上升 afflicting querent 与所问之事；九宫主木星（教职/恩俸 significator）与上升主及月亮皆无相位、无接纳、无传光/收光；上升主与月亮皆不在九宫；月亮离三合后入对冲三宫主水星，主消息/中介转 adverse；金星在七宫冲上升，主对方反对。七项负证言同向且无任何一项成象的正面证言可抵，故终局为 negative、求而不得。此问为单点成败，不适用两段式，应期不另定点。
summary: He shall not obtain the desired parsonage — all horary testimonies are negative and no perfection between significators exists.
